kind: band decision rule for the rank profile
status: COMMITTED BEFORE ANY RANK PROFILE IS COMPUTED
required_by: authority R-1 step 2, which says the decision rule is committed before the computation

the_profile.quantity: readrate(layer) = fraction of scored intermediates whose lens rank at that layer is <= k
the_profile.k_primary_justification: verbatim from the official Hit definition: 'a target token is a hit if it appears at lens rank 1'. It is not a value we chose.
the_profile.per_set_and_pooled: one profile per evaluation set plus one pooled profile over all scored intermediates
the_profile.why_pooled: the six sets probe different content; pooling avoids letting a single set's idiosyncrasy define the band, and the per-set profiles are still reported so any such idiosyncrasy is visible

readout_positions_executed_verbatim_neve.multihop: the token immediately preceding `target`; `target` itself is not scored
readout_positions_executed_verbatim_neve.multilingual: the token immediately preceding `target`; `target` itself is not scored
readout_positions_executed_verbatim_neve.order-ops: the token immediately preceding `target`; `target` itself is not scored
readout_positions_executed_verbatim_neve.poetry: the last newline token, end of line 1 of the couplet
readout_positions_executed_verbatim_neve.association: the final prompt token, the closing period
readout_positions_executed_verbatim_neve.typo: the final prompt token, the last tokenizer fragment of the misspelling
readout_positions_executed_verbatim_neve.order_ops_special_rule: each intermediate is a key expanded to a synonym set (numbers to digit and word forms, operations to symbol and word forms); the rank at each layer is the MINIMUM over the single-token synonyms

band_rule.definition: the longest contiguous run of layers whose pass@1 readrate is at least half of the profile's maximum readrate
band_rule.why_half_of_maximum: scale-free, contains no absolute threshold, and is the same shape rule EQ1 used for C2. Applied here to an externally defined, label-driven quantity rather than to a statistic of our own construction.
band_rule.interior_requirement: the band's argmax must not sit on either endpoint of the layer range, since a maximum at an endpoint is what a monotone trend looks like, not a band
band_rule.degenerate_case: if the maximum readrate is 0, no content is readable at any layer and NO band exists; this is reported as such and is not rescued by lowering k

positive_control.role: its derived band is the EXTERNAL REFERENCE BAND for this invocation

negative_control.expectation_registered_now: under a discriminative method it should NOT show a band
negative_control.if_it_does: the method is not discriminative; stop, do not proceed to the target; terminal state STUDY5_EQ2_NEGATIVE_CONTROL_CONTAMINATED

depth_test.question: does a 1.7B model show a band
depth_test.if_yes: '28 layers is too shallow' is refuted by external data
depth_test.if_no: this says nothing about whether the target has a band, and must not be read as supporting the shallowness explanation either

conventions: V, vocabulary axis, as EQ1 computed
kurtosis_adjudication.criterion: whichever convention's band agrees better with the rank-derived reference band
kurtosis_adjudication.agreement_measure: Jaccard index of the two layer sets

if_neither_agrees.action: record that kurtosis is not a valid locator under this method

what_is_frozen_by_this_commit: k = 1 as the primary readrate threshold
the per-set readout positions, executed verbatim
the pooled profile as the band source
the Jaccard agreement measure for V versus D
claim_ceiling: A decision rule. It licenses no claim of any kind.
